text:
Maya Chen: Quick check-in — propose we scope Optimize toolkit v1 to a very small, low-risk "golden path": adaptive batching + prefix KV cache + eval-triggered alerts. Keep quantization recommendations out of runtime; provide a short advisory for pilots. Thoughts?

Danielle Rivera: I support narrow scope. Need clear, measurable launch gates though. What exactly are we measuring for econ and alert fidelity?

Ajay Patel: From infra: adaptive batching + prefix cache is doable with a minimal admission-control layer. Risk is admission + autoscaling interactions. Quant recs need offline eval infra; that's a larger project.

Leo Wong: Proposed acceptance metrics: econ >=15% token-cost improvement on pilot routes over rolling 7 days; latency p95 no worse than +10% vs baseline; alert precision >=80% on seeded regressions. If any metric fails, pause rollout for that route.

Sasha Kumar: Customer note — two pilots (NoteFlow, BeaconDocs) want quant guidance. They'll accept a labeled "experimental advisory" PDF for now if we commit a timeline for proper quant recs. I can draft it.

Maya Chen: Good. Sasha to own advisory draft. Danielle to own acceptance checklist and release gates. Ajay to spike adaptive batching admission control this week. Leo to wire econ dashboards.

Ajay Patel: Spike plan: build small admission-control config (max_wait_ms=25, min_batch_size=3, cost_threshold_usd=0.00035) and test with synthetic traces. Need a feature flag for per-route batching toggle.

ci-bot: CI build for optimize-toolkit/spike succeeded. Canary image: sha256:abc123 posted to registry.

Danielle Rivera: Launch gates proposed: 1) bench on 3 representative prompt sets, 2) seeded regression tests for alert precision, 3) per-route UI toggle + docs, 4) pilot onboarding playbook.

Leo Wong: Add business rule: measure early econ in first 72 hours; if improvement <8% on a route, auto-disable batching for that route and notify owners. Capture user-visible latency metrics too.

Maya Chen: Decision: ship MVP with adaptive batching + prefix cache + eval alerts; provide quant advisory PDF for pilots but do not include quant recs in v1 runtime. Action items and owners noted. Aim for pilot rollout next week. :rocket:
